full_judgment:
6. The learned trial Court Judge examined only one P.W. on behalf of the plaintiffs and the learned Assistant Judge on consideration of the evidence on record dismissed the suit on the ground that the plaintiffs have not succeeded to prove that in the disputed R.S. Khatian No.295 is the land of that Plot No.611. In the impugned judgment it was also found that the plaintiff has failed to prove ownership and title over the suit Plot No.2333. 

 "... On perusal of these I found that the plaintiff has acquired title in the suit plot No.611 by way of lease from the Government but the land described in the disputed R.S. Khatian No.295 in the land of that plot No.611 it has not been proved in any way. So, the case of the plaintiff so as to ownership and title over the suit plot No.2333 of the schedule to the plaint is disproved till now ..."
